title: A Kubernetes pod is not running

steps.say: Which cluster kubectl is talking to.
STATUS and RESTARTS: Pending, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, Error, OOMKilled.
The reason. Events at the bottom: a failed image pull, no node fits (FailedScheduling), a failing probe. Last State: OOMKilled means it ran out of memory. Controlled By: what recreates it.
CrashLoopBackOff: the log of the run that crashed.
Everything that happened in the namespace lately, newest last.
Pending: are the nodes Ready, and is one cordoned (SchedulingDisabled)?
After fixing the cause, replace the pod: its deployment, statefulset or daemonset starts a new one.
steps.rollback: Not needed when Controlled By (step 3) names a ReplicaSet, StatefulSet or DaemonSet: it starts a new pod. A pod with no controller is gone for good.

steps.say: The new pod should reach Running with READY n/n.
